text.description_html:
Acorn PMH-T-03, Stainless Steel Rousseau Cabinet Knob

A unique shape indeed, the Rousseau Cabinet Knob is perfect for fashion forward thinkers who love an ultra modern design motif. This knob was made to make a statement; it breaks the present thoughts of what modernism looks like while, at the same time, bringing in elements of classic shapes found in space and sea exploration. It has a brushed stainless steel finish and comes packaged with all the necessary installation hardware.

Also Available Matching Rousseau Cabinet Pull

Specifications of the Rousseau Cabinet Knob:

  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Width: 15/16"
  • Projection: 1-3/8"
  • Package includes 1 knob and hardware for installation.

Sold individually.

** This item is being discontinued. Very limited quantities available.
